item.title: [LU-18597] statahead: statahead thread doesn't stop on unmount
item.description:
The visible problem is that Lustre FS mounted on the client is unable to unmount. The umount command hangs forever and also unable to kill it.

 

Stack trace for the umount command

[<0>] ll_kill_super+0x6d/0x140 [lustre]
[<0>] lustre_kill_super+0x32/0x50 [lustre]
[<0>] deactivate_locked_super+0x38/0xb0
[<0>] deactivate_super+0x44/0x50
[<0>] cleanup_mnt+0x150/0x1d0
[<0>] __cleanup_mnt+0x12/0x20
[<0>] task_work_run+0x6a/0xb0
[<0>] exit_to_user_mode_loop+0x157/0x160
[<0>] exit_to_user_mode_prepare+0xa0/0xb0
[<0>] syscall_exit_to_user_mode+0x27/0x50
[<0>] do_syscall_64+0x69/0xc0
[<0>] entry_SYSCALL_64_after_hwframe+0x62/0xcc

statahead thread stack:

# cat stack
[<0>] ll_statahead_thread+0x2fd/0x1b20 [lustre]
[<0>] kthread+0x127/0x150
[<0>] ret_from_fork+0x1f/0x30

A similar problem is fixed here - https://jira.whamcloud.com/browse/LU-15660 . However, that is fixed in the client version used 2.15.5

Environment:

Lustre client, Kubernetes environment. 
Ubuntu client 22.04 with kernel version 5.15.0-1045
Lustre mounted via CSI driver
 

Since it is a Kubernetes environment, there is a need to mount and unmount the Lustre file system every time the container starts on the worker node. When the above problem happens, the node becomes unavailable for any containers to be started taking it offline until the node is rebooted.
